rationale: The agent verified identity correctly via full name + zip and accessed only the authenticated user’s data. However, it executed order-changing writes without obtaining explicit confirmation first. It updated the shipping address immediately after the user provided a correction, without restating the exact change and asking to proceed. More importantly, it replaced the jigsaw item in the pending order without first specifying the exact replacement SKU, price difference, and seeking explicit approval, which the policy requires before any order-modifying action. The rest of the information provided (use of PayPal, refund due to lower price) appears consistent with tool outputs, but the missing confirmation steps before writes violate the pass bar.
